B. bacteriovorous LexA, despite being the first δ-Proteobacterial LexA characterized, does not regulate the canonical SOS genes, which are not repressed in this bacterium but are instead constitutively expressed, suggesting that this bacterium may not require a stringent control of its SOS system.
